summary: Comprehensive testing of Signal Bot MVP - all 17 backend API tests passed, all frontend pages verified working with Bloomberg Terminal dark theme.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~540 lines - acceptable size but could be split into route files if grows further
CORS is set to '*' via CORS_ORIGINS env - fine for dev but should be restricted in production
register endpoint allows unauthenticated users to create accounts (role defaults to 'user') - by design but worth noting
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_user_001 during register test (cleanup may be needed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows working. Backend: auth (login/register/me/logout), signals, bot status (pause/resume), config, performance, exchanges, dashboard all return correct responses. Frontend: Login page with Bloomberg dark theme (rgb(10,14,26)), Dashboard with TradingView chart (BTC/USDT), active positions panel showing BNB/USDT LONG with INST TP/INST SL/SL→BEP buttons, mode tabs (ALL/SWING/SCALP/HYBRID), exchange filters (ALL/DEMO/BINANCE/BYBIT/OKX/BITGET), Signals page with signal rows, Performance page with KPI cards (WIN RATE/NET PNL/TOTAL TRADES/AVG HOLD/ACTIVE), Settings page with all 4 tabs (BOT CONFIG/EXCHANGES/INTEGRATIONS/CONTROLS), Integrations tab shows Telegram/Notion/CoinGecko fields, Controls tab shows PAUSE/SCAN NOW buttons with RUNNING status.
